blocks.content: • Award compensation to victims of pollution.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NGT has the power to award financial compensation to pollution victims and order environment restitution.
It can impose environmental penalties and issue binding directions to authorities.
The Tribunal holds the authority to suspend or completely cancel environmental clearances.
NGT operates based on the principles of natural justice rather than procedural constraints of the Civil Procedure Code.

blocks.content: NGT is NOT bound by the Civil Procedure Code and follows principles of natural justice.
